note: Dates verified against the linked sources on the as_of date. 'expected' dates are projections from the prior year's timing and must be confirmed by policy-radar before they drive an action.

events.title: Medicaid work requirements begin in 44 states
events.detail: Expansion adults ages 19 to 64 must report 80 hours a month of qualifying activity. About 30% of Medicaid beneficiaries are subject. Excluded states: WY, TX, KS, MS, AL, FL, SC.

events.title: Six-month eligibility renewals for expansion adults
events.detail: Expansion adults are redetermined every six months instead of annually, doubling the number of points where coverage can lapse.

events.title: Optional CMS hold-harmless period on work-requirement disenrollments
events.detail: States that elect it must still assess compliance from January 1 but cannot deny or disenroll solely for failing the requirement until June 30, 2027. Which states elect it changes when coverage losses hit cash.

events.title: 2027 Medicare physician fee schedule takes effect
events.detail: Conversion factor $32.63 for non-qualifying APM clinicians (-2.31%) and $32.95 for qualifying APM participants (-1.83%).

events.title: 2027 outpatient (OPPS/ASC) rule takes effect
events.detail: 2.3% base update for hospitals meeting quality reporting, 340B drug payment cut (about $4.35 billion first-year Medicare savings), site-neutral pay extended to off-campus imaging without contrast (about $260 million in 2027; rural sole community hospitals exempt).

events.title: Illinois HB 5000 transaction notice law effective
events.detail: Notice requirement covers transactions above the facility level and expressly includes private equity companies.

events.title: California parallel HSR notice to the Attorney General
events.detail: HSR filers must give parallel notice to the California AG when nexus thresholds are met.

events.title: Vermont private equity and hedge fund ownership reports due
events.detail: Reports cover interests held as of June 1, 2026 (H.583 / Act 133).

events.title: Illinois HB 4728 disclosures start for developmental disability providers
events.detail: Quarterly disclosures and 90 days' notice of certain transactions. Penalties up to $50,000.

events.title: HIPAA Security Rule overhaul: final action targeted
events.detail: HHS pushed the final rule to July 2027. Proposed provisions (not final) include mandatory encryption, MFA and asset inventories.

events.title: CY 2028 proposed physician and outpatient rules (expected)
events.detail: In 2026 CMS released the proposed outpatient rule on July 2 and the physician rule on July 14. Expect the 2028 versions in early to mid July 2027.

events.title: Medicaid provider tax safe harbor begins phasing down (FFY 2028)
events.detail: Expansion states step down from 6% toward 3.5%. Nursing homes and ICFs are exempt from the phase-down.

events.title: CY 2028 final physician and outpatient rules (expected)
events.detail: The 2027 final rules were released November 4, 2026. Expect 2028 finals in early November 2027.

events.title: State-directed payment phase-down begins
events.detail: Payments above 100% of Medicare (expansion states) or 110% (non-expansion) fall 10 percentage points a year. First-year federal cut estimated at $8.7 billion.

events.title: Oregon SB 951 compliance deadline for most existing MSO arrangements
events.detail: Oregon's corporate practice law limits MSO ownership and control of medical groups. Most existing arrangements have until January 1, 2029.
